description: Memory tools test case 1. Tests that agents can retrieve information from memory and inbox emails to perform complex email tasks. Session 1: 5 memory setup queries. Session 2: 5 emails inserted into inbox. Session 3: 5 reply/forward/send email queries requiring both memory and email information.

steps.user_message: For context, here's my health info for today: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge or note the health information: medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, readings 120/80 and 118/78, daily log ID HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
Thanks — got it. I’ve recorded: medication at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM; BP readings 120/80 (morning) and 118/78 (evening); daily log ID HL-8842 (today is 2026-02-22).

What would you like me to do with this information? Options:
- Send an email to your clinician (I can draft and send now).
- Save it as a draft in your drafts folder.
- Forward it to a family member/caregiver.
- Just store it as a note (I can draft an email to yourself for records).
- Anything else.

Below are ready-to-send templates — pick one and tell me the recipient email (or say “draft” to save instead of send), and any tweaks you want.

1) Email to clinician
Subject: Daily blood pressure log — HL-8842 (22 Feb 2026)
Body: Hello Dr. [Last name],  
Today I took my blood pressure medication at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. My readings were 120/80 (morning) and 118/78 (evening). Daily log ID: HL-8842. Please let me know if you recommend any adjustments. Thank you, [Your name]

2) Email to caregiver/family
Subject: Today's BP update — HL-8842
Body: Hi [Name],  
Quick update: I took my BP meds at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Readings: 120/80 (morning), 118/78 (evening). Log ID: HL-8842. —[Your name]

3) Save to records / email yourself
Subject: BP log HL-8842 (22 Feb 2026)
Body: Entry: Medication at 08:00 and 20:00. Readings: 120/80 (AM), 118/78 (PM). Log ID HL-8842. No symptoms reported. —[Your name]

Tell me:
- Which template to use (1, 2, or 3) or a custom message,
- Recipient email (or say “draft to me”),
- Any edits to the text or subject,
- Send now or save as draft.

steps.description: Insert email into inbox containing: Hello, please share your medication schedule and blood pressure readings for today. I need the times you took your medication and both readings.
Start new session to test reply/forward/send email with memory and email information

My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.

[Your name]
